freePlan.limits: Basic RSS reading with a limited number of sources/feeds; no AI Feeds.

keyLimits.en: Advanced features and enhanced sharing beyond the free tier; billed annually (~$72/year).

Adds AI Feeds (Leo AI) that analyze articles, reports and social posts, plus an RSS Builder for sites without native RSS. A discounted first-year introductory rate (~$8.25/mo, $99/yr) was seen and is excluded from the compare price.
Team/organization intelligence workflows (Threat Intelligence, Market Intelligence, Biopharma Research, Competitive Intelligence); third-party sources report pricing starting around $1,600/month.

cautions.en: Pro+ has been seen advertised at a discounted first-year rate (~$99/year); the regular recurring price is closer to $144/year ($12/mo equivalent) or $12.99/mo billed monthly. Exact current figures could not be confirmed on an official Feedly page during this pass and should be re-verified.

capabilities.en: Aggregates RSS/Atom feeds, blogs, news sites and YouTube channels into a single reading stream.
AI Feeds (Leo AI) on Pro+ that filter, prioritize and summarize large volumes of articles around a topic.
RSS Builder to generate a feed for websites that don't publish native RSS.
Enterprise-tier intelligence modules for market, threat, biopharma and competitive monitoring.

limitations.en: The free plan has no AI-assisted filtering (Leo AI) and a limited number of sources, so serious monitoring workflows require Pro+ or Enterprise.
Official pricing page (feedly.com) was not reliably reachable via automated tools during this research pass, so exact current prices rely partly on third-party sources.

reason.en: Overlaps on aggregating and prioritizing reading material, though Readwise focuses more on highlights/annotations than live feed monitoring.
